title: EC2 SSH Connection Times Out
symptom: Engineer attempts to connect to an Amazon EC2 instance via SSH (`ssh -i key.pem ec2-user@203.0.113.10`) and receives: 'ssh: connect to host 203.0.113.10 port 22: Connection timed out'.
initial_observations: SSH client hangs for approximately 30-60 seconds before printing 'Connection timed out'.
The instance shows 'running' state in the AWS Management Console.
environment: Amazon Linux 2 / 2023 EC2 instance in a public subnet with an attached Elastic IP.

possible_causes.cause: Security Group does not permit inbound TCP port 22 from the engineer's public IP
possible_causes.evidence_needed: ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups showing no rule for port 22 or CIDR mismatch.
possible_causes.remediation: Add an inbound rule to the instance's Security Group authorizing TCP port 22 from your specific IP/32.

possible_causes.cause: Subnet Route Table missing route to Internet Gateway (0.0.0.0/0 -> igw-xxx)
possible_causes.evidence_needed: ec2:DescribeRouteTables showing no default 0.0.0.0/0 route to an attached IGW.
possible_causes.remediation: Attach an Internet Gateway to the VPC and add route 0.0.0.0/0 pointing to the IGW ID.

possible_causes.cause: Network ACL (NACL) blocking inbound port 22 or outbound ephemeral ports (1024-65535)
possible_causes.evidence_needed: ec2:DescribeNetworkAcls showing a Deny rule before Allow or missing outbound return rule.
possible_causes.remediation: Update subnet NACL to allow inbound port 22 and outbound ephemeral ports (1024-65535).

investigation_steps.title: Verify Instance State and Public IP Assignment
investigation_steps.explanation: Confirm instance is running and has a public IPv4 address assigned.

investigation_steps.title: Inspect Inbound Security Group Rules for Port 22
investigation_steps.explanation: Verify an ingress rule exists allowing TCP port 22 from your current public IP.
investigation_steps.what_to_look_for: Check IpRanges CIDR against your public IP (obtained via 'curl https://checkip.amazonaws.com').

investigation_steps.title: Check Subnet Route Table for Internet Gateway Route
investigation_steps.explanation: A public subnet must have a 0.0.0.0/0 route target matching igw-xxxxxxxx.
investigation_steps.what_to_look_for: DestinationCidrBlock 0.0.0.0/0 with GatewayId starting with igw-.

investigation_steps.title: Inspect Subnet Network ACL Rules (Inbound and Outbound)
investigation_steps.explanation: NACLs are stateless. Inbound must allow port 22, and outbound must allow ephemeral ports 1024-65535.
investigation_steps.what_to_look_for: Deny rule numbered lower than Allow rule.

verification: Execute `ssh -v -i key.pem ec2-user@<public-ip>` and confirm the TCP handshake succeeds (OpenSSH banner exchange starts).
prevention: Use AWS Systems Manager (SSM) Session Manager for shell access without exposing port 22 to the public internet.
Use EC2 Instance Connect with specific IP prefixes or client VPN.
